game: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas - The Definitive Edition

totalClaimed.gtabase: 48 (35 PS incl. platinum + 13 Social Club-exclusive; 34 Xbox)
totalClaimed.gta.wiki: 48 (13 SC-exclusive listed verbatim; details section says 5 new SC-exclusive + 8 carried over from retired versions)
totalClaimed.Steam thread: 13 in-game achievements not shown on Steam, numbered 36-48, viewable in Rockstar launcher overlay / Social Club site

list.name: Hoopin' it Up
list.description: Score at least 30 points in the basketball mini-game.

list.name: Pay 'n' Spray
list.description: Use a Pay 'n' Spray while wanted.

list.name: Bike or Biker
list.description: Complete either the BMX or NRG challenge.

list.name: Who Needs Directions?
list.description: Find Mike Toreno without using any of the referenced locations during "Mike Toreno".

list.name: They Can't Stop All of Us
list.description: Enter the underground base during "Black Project" without triggering the above-ground alarm.

list.name: Yes I Speak English
list.description: Complete 50 fares in the Taxi Driver side mission.
list.notes: Leak wording: 'Reach 50 fares in Taxi mode'.

list.name: Lucky Spinner
list.description: Win at least $1,000 in a single spin of the Wheel of Fortune.

list.name: All Dressed Up for San Fierro
Not a Player
list.description: Go on a date with every potential girlfriend.

list.name: What are the Odds
list.description: Win a race in Inside Track Betting.

list.name: Double or Nothin'
list.description: Bet all your money or the maximum on red or black and win.

list.name: Assassin
list.description: Stealth kill all enemies in "Madd Dogg's Rhymes".

list.name: Today Was a Good Day
list.description: Go 24 in-game hours without breaking the law, being wanted, killing or harming anyone.

list.name: Ain't Nothing But a G Thing
list.description: Own all gang turfs and properties and have $1,000,000.

list.name: ...Here we go again
list.description: Start a new game after reaching 100% on a save file.

list.name: I Ain't No Buster
list.notes: PS platinum. gtabase and leak count it as #35 of the 48, but Xbox has only 34 so it is not a normal achievement; whether the Social Club list for a Switch account contains it is UNCONFIRMED (SC list could be 47 on Switch).

list.name: Sticky Fingers
list.notes: Amount disputed: $10,000 per gta.wiki and gtabase summaries.

list.name: 81 Years Too Late
list.description: Spend 24 hours on foot in the countryside (looking for Bigfoot).
list.notes: Whether 24 hours is in-game or real time not stated.

list.name: Get a Pump
list.description: Do a barbell curl or benchpress at any gym.

list.name: Beat the Cock
list.description: Win the Beat the Cock! marathon.
list.notes: Name censored as 'Beat the ****' on Steam.

list.name: Metrosexual
list.description: Spend $6,969 on clothes, hair, and tattoos.
list.notes: Cumulative spend; in-game counter not confirmed.

list.name: Where'd He Go?
list.description: Escape the police 20 times using the Pay 'n' Spray.

list.name: High As a Kite
list.description: Fly as high as possible / hit the height limit.
list.notes: Wording differs between sources (gta.wiki 'Fly as high as possible / Hit the height limit'; others 'Fly to the height limit').

list.name: Time to Kill
list.description: Watch the credits to the end.

list.name: Lots of Guns
list.notes: Which weapon set counts is not stated.

conflicts: Sticky Fingers amount: $50,000 (player.one leaked list; Steam thread) vs $10,000 (gta.wiki and gtabase, both read through a summarizing fetch). Unresolved.
Yes I Speak English: 'Complete 50 fares in the Taxi Driver side mission' vs 'Reach 50 fares in Taxi mode' (leak).
Platinum 'I Ain't No Buster' included in the 48 by gtabase/leak although PS-only; Social Club count for Switch could be 47 or 48.

gta.wiki says 13 are Social Club exclusive but its details section says only 5 are new and 8 carried over from retired versions' gameplay achievements. Both agree they are not on the PS/Xbox DE lists.
Descriptions of the 13 SC-only come from summarized fetches (gta.wiki gave quoted wording); no Rockstar Social Club page was retrieved, so exact punctuation is unverified.
gaps: No direct Rockstar Social Club page seen; names and counts come from gtabase, gta.wiki, Steam thread and a pre-release leak.
No source confirms Switch syncs Social Club accomplishments (user states they confirmed it).
No source says any of the 48 references content missing from the Switch version; none seen.
In-game counters for the SC-only items (burglary money, arrests, Pay 'n' Spray escapes, clothes spend, Bigfoot hours) are not confirmed as displayed.
